The load-bearing spine is sound and verified: terminal-event barrier (E17) freezes correctly (step returns before state mutates -> exactly one terminal event, tested); determinism holds over the full loop incl the terminal frame (win/lose/goal/tick_cap/terminal/outcome ride the T1 hash + serialize; WIN loop byte-identical-replay unit-tested, LOSE loop golden-covered + drift-rejected); package core is engine-free (no imports in win_lose/step/flow/types/serialize); win/lose gating is independent + win-beats-lose (tested, incl the cap-only-lose regression). odin test core = 27/27; odin build app (CI mode) OK; harness drift 29/29 rejected; harness run 5/5 green (boot/flow/win/draw/lose). Findings are test-coverage completeness + harness-edge notes, not correctness defects.

findings.title: Missing 'retry-restores-clean-state test' (spec-named Golden contract) + app Mode FSM untested
findings.evidence: Story 1.4 names the test ('retry-restores-clean-state test'). CODE restart_run -> start_run -> run_destroy + run_init (zeroes) + fresh_seed (crypto.rand_bytes) + mode/tick/accum/drag reset. No restart_run/fresh_seed test exists; no app/*_test.odin at all. (Reviewer agreement: 2 independent lenses.)
findings.detail: Spec-named test artifact absent. Behavior is VERIFIED CORRECT (clean fresh-context reset, fresh crypto seed, no leakage) and core-level fresh-context is tested, but the app restart orchestration + Mode FSM transitions (Run->Game_Over, Game_Over->Run) have zero automated coverage.
findings.recommended_fix: Lift start_run/restart_run reset into a raylib-free core/app helper; add a headless test: run to terminal, restart, assert score=0/events cleared/terminal=false/outcome=None and a fresh seed differs. Pins the named contract.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.evidence: 27 core tests pass; 0 @(test) in app/ or harness/.
findings.detail: P0 core sim contracts 100% (WIN/LOSE/barrier/tie/disable/cap-only). Overall ~85%. CONCERNS: named 'clean restart' contract untested (app-layer) and LOSE-loop replay is golden-only (no core unit test). Harness integration (5/5 demos, 29/29 drift) mitigates but is not unit coverage.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the restart test, a LOSE-loop byte-identical-replay test, and a self-delivery score test -> gate to PASS.

findings.title: win_lose_eval's own terminal guard is redundant given step's barrier (defense-in-depth)
findings.evidence: step.odin:36 `if state.terminal { return }` runs BEFORE flow_step + win_lose_eval; flow_step never sets terminal. win_lose_eval:36 repeats the check. Docstring concedes 'Idempotent via the caller's terminal guard'.
findings.detail: With the current call structure the inner check is unreachable. It is intentional defense-in-depth (documented), not a defect.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: reword the comment to state it is intentional defense-in-depth for future direct callers, or drop it.

findings.title: Demo win-goal >= 2^32 silently truncates via u32(v) (no range guard)
findings.evidence: `v, ok := strconv.parse_uint(fields[2], 10)` ... `d.win_goal = u32(v)` (uint->u32, no range check).
findings.detail: An out-of-range goal in a .dem fixture truncates (e.g. 4294967296 -> 0 -> WIN disabled). Harness demo-fixture parse path only; not core, not untrusted input. Impact nil in practice (goals are small packet counts).
findings.recommended_fix: Range-check before the cast (v > uint(u32(max)) -> the existing 'bad win goal' parse error).

findings.title: Sub-tick lose cap_ms floors to tick_cap 0, silently disabling lose (harness-only)
findings.evidence: `state.tick_cap = u64(max(0, cfg.cap_ms * i64(hz) / 1000))`; win_lose treats tick_cap==0 as 'no cap'.
findings.detail: A cap_ms < 1000/hz (e.g. 25ms @ 20Hz) integer-divides to 0 -> lose disabled. HARNESS/DEMO path only (parsing 'lose cap <n>ms' from .dem); the playable app uses LOSE_TICK_CAP ticks directly (app/main.odin:31,143), unaffected. Low impact.
findings.recommended_fix: Floor to 1 tick when cap_ms > 0 (max(1, ...)) so any set cap still loses, or reject sub-tick caps in parse_demo.

findings.title: App Mode FSM transitions (Run<->Game_Over) untested
findings.detail: Driving core flags (terminal/outcome) are unit-tested; the app FSM transitions are not. Related to the restart-coverage warning. Acceptable for a stub, honest gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Unit-test the mode-decision logic decoupled from raylib input/render to pin the transitions.

findings.title: LOSE-loop byte-identical replay is golden-only; no core unit test mirroring the WIN test
findings.evidence: win_lose_test pins replay for the WIN loop only (contract (f)). The LOSE loop's terminal frame + frozen post-terminal ticks are covered by the harness golden lose.t1 (drift-check rejects lose mutations), not by a core test.
findings.detail: Determinism over the LOSE loop IS verified (golden + drift), but there is no core unit test mirroring test_win_loop_replay_byte_identical for LOSE. Completeness gap, not a determinism break.
findings.recommended_fix: Add test_lose_loop_replay_byte_identical: incomplete graph + tick_cap, assert live==replay hash sequence incl the frozen tail.

findings.title: Degenerate 'spawned at own dst' score increment (flow.odin:151) untested
findings.evidence: `if p.at_node == p.dst { p.delivered = true; state.score += 1 }` (the second score increment, a 1.4 behavior).
findings.detail: No test seeds a self-dst spawn; only the normal delivery score (flow.odin:142) is exercised by test_win_on_goal_reached. A 1.4 behavior change with no test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a test spawning a packet whose src==dst and assert score increments + Run_Won when goal is met.
